subject: general
question: A train P going at the speed of 70 km/h completely passes train Q of length 170 m, going in the same direction on parallel tracks, at 56 km/h, in 1 (1)/(2) minutes. How much time (in seconds) will P take to cross completely train R of length 220 m, going at 74 km/h in the opposite direction?
solution: Given: Speed of the faster train (Q) = 56 kmph Speed of the slower train (P) = 70 kmph Speed of the slower train (R) = 74 kmph Length of the train Q = 170m
